summary.text: J.D. Williams is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 2, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: J.D. Williams was born in Scottsbluff, Nebraska, and earned a B.S. in agricultural economics from the University of Wyoming in 1997.
Williams's career experience includes working as a rancher.

Williams was appointed to the Wyoming House of Representatives District 2 seat at a joint meeting of the Goshen, Niobrara and Weston County Commissioners in 2021, after Hans Hunt resigned, and served until 2023.
Williams won the seat again in the 2024 general election, defeating incumbent Allen Slagle in that year's Republican primary, and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
For 2025-2026, Williams is co-chair of the Select Natural Resource Funding Committee and sits on the House Education Committee.
